title: Derivation of the equation of isostatic line of compression and splitting force in a bottle-shaped strut
author: Yuan, Aikebaier, et al.

steps.title: Value of the data
steps.instruction: •The data provide the detailed derivation process of the equation of isostatic line of compression.•The data provide a formula to calculate the magnitude of the splitting force•The data provide a formula to determine the location of the resultant splitting force.•The data serves as a methodological benchmark for further attempts to improve the formula of the splitting force subjected to different geometric and boundary conditions.

steps.title: Data
steps.instruction: •Considering the different assumptions based on the previous researches, A mathematic and explicit describing the equation of ILCs is established.•Splitting force formulae for the struts with different load area ratios are obtained.
